info.name: DFS - Corporate Portal (AgentApp)
info.description:
Token-free replicas of changempin, getbalance and miniStatment for the Corporate Portal, plus the corporate onboarding call that now accepts parentCommission.

## Authentication

The three /v1/corporate/* endpoints are NOT authenticated with an app login token. The portal is a server-side web application with no handset and no app login, so it authenticates as itself with a shared key in the `X-Portal-Key` header.

Set the `portalKey` collection variable to the value of `CORPORATE_PORTAL_API_KEY` from the server's .env file. It is deliberately not stored in this file.

Each request still names its own subject through `payload.mobileNumber`, exactly as the mobile calls do. The portal key authorises the caller as the portal; it does not select the account.

## What is NOT here

The existing mobile endpoints (/v1/changempin, /v1/getbalance, /v1/miniStatment) are unchanged and still require a bearer token. The portal key gives no access to them.

variable.description: AgentApp base URL, including the /agentapp context path.
CORPORATE_PORTAL_API_KEY from the server .env. Leave blank here; fill it in your own environment so it is never committed.
The agent account the request acts on.
Account level of that account. getbalance and miniStatment match on mobile AND level - a level that does not match the account returns USER NOT FOUND.

item.name: Corporate Portal
item.description: The three replicas. Same validators, same service methods and same responses as the mobile endpoints they mirror.

request.description:
Mirrors POST /v1/getbalance.

Required: payload.mobileNumber, payload.accountLevelCode.

imieNo is optional here - the portal has no handset, and the field is filled with a fixed marker when omitted. The service layer never reads it.

Success: {"responsecode":"000","data":{"balance":4681},"messages":"SUCCESS"}

Mirrors POST /v1/miniStatment.

Leave fromDate and toDate out (or empty) and the last nine transactions are returned.

Note the endpoint spelling: miniStatment, not miniStatement. It matches the existing mobile endpoint.

Both dates must be supplied together, in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

The range may not exceed 180 days; a wider range is rejected.

Mirrors POST /v1/changempin.

Required: mobileNumber, currentMpin, newMpin, confirmMpin. newMpin and confirmMpin must match.

The user is resolved from mobileNumber, so no token or user id is needed.

A wrong currentMpin returns responsecode 127 (Wrong Mpin) with HTTP 200 - it is a business outcome, not an error.

Corporate Onboarding
item.description: Unchanged endpoint, two new behaviours: it accepts parentCommission, and it returns the new agentId.

request.description:
No token: this call authenticates no header, the same position agentDeviceRegistration was in.

parentAgentId makes the new agent a sub-agent. parentCommission is the percentage the parent earns on it, written to TBL_AGENT_COMMISSION_DISTRIBUTION at AGENT_LEVEL 1.

Both are optional and independent:
- neither -> a standalone agent, no distribution row
- parentAgentId only -> a sub-agent, no distribution row
- both -> a sub-agent with the distribution row

Rejected if the agent named by parentAgentId is itself a sub-agent:
{"responsecode":"163","messages":"A child agent cannot be assigned as a parent agent.","data":null}
Nothing is written when that happens.

A non-numeric parentCommission returns responsecode 111 with "Parent commission must be a number".

Success returns the new agent id and nothing else:
{"responsecode":"000","messages":"SUCCESS","data":{"agentId":1234}}

request.description:
Same endpoint, multipart form. Use this whenever documents are attached - base64 inside JSON is held several times over in memory and has killed the container mid-request.

Parts:
- request  : the JSON envelope, with payload.documents left out
- documents: repeated once per file, same part name each time

Do not set Content-Type by hand; Postman adds the multipart boundary.

formdata.description: One part per file. Repeat this exact key for each document.
